_comment: Project fidelity config for SPX exchange screen (figma 917:11876). Tolerances mirror account-states / amount-states / input-master. Single [data-figma-root='917:11876'] canvas — full-screen rebuild covering all sections in one diff. Gate: ≥85% / 0 critical / 0 major.

iconDeviations.name: ^Linear / Arrows / Round Transfer
iconDeviations.reason: Swap-currencies icon between sell/buy cells uses Feather 'refresh-cw' (app-wide @expo/vector-icons). Geometry/box validated; vector-path identity waived consistent with account-states / amount-states precedent for Feather glyph substitutes.

iconDeviations.name: ^Linear / Arrows / Restart
iconDeviations.reason: 汇率列表 search-box restart icon collapsed into Feather 'search' (the figma master ships an unused Restart inside the search-input INSTANCE; the impl renders just the magnifier).

iconDeviations.name: ^Linear / Essentional, UI / Danger Circle
iconDeviations.reason: Inline rate alert (red warning circle next to 1:7.162) uses Feather 'alert-triangle' as the app-wide approximation. Vector-path waived.

iconDeviations.name: ^Linear / Essentional, UI / Question Circle
iconDeviations.reason: 手续费规则 question-mark icon uses Feather 'info'. Vector-path waived.

iconDeviations.name: ^Linear / Essentional, UI / Close Circle
iconDeviations.reason: Toast x-circle icon uses Feather 'x-circle'. Vector-path waived.

iconDeviations.name: ^Outline / Search / Minimalistic Magnifer
iconDeviations.reason: Search-box magnifier icon uses Feather 'search'. Vector-path waived.

iconDeviations.name: ^Linear / Arrows / (Alt )?Arrow Left
iconDeviations.reason: Nav-back chevron uses Feather 'chevron-left'. Vector-path waived.

iconDeviations.name: ^Linear / Money / Wallet
iconDeviations.reason: Bottom-nav 账户 tab icon uses Feather 'credit-card' as the active-state wallet glyph. Vector-path waived per app-wide @expo/vector-icons mapping.

iconDeviations.name: ^Linear / Money / Card
iconDeviations.reason: Bottom-nav 消费 tab icon uses Feather 'shopping-bag' as the inactive-state card glyph. Vector-path waived.

iconDeviations.name: ^Linear / Users / User Circle
iconDeviations.reason: Bottom-nav 我的 tab icon uses Feather 'user'. Vector-path waived.

iconDeviations.name: ^arrow-up$
iconDeviations.reason: Currency dropdown chevron-up (sell cell open state) rendered as inline SVG path approximating the figma 11.67×5 arrow. Vector-path identity waived.

iconDeviations.name: ^arrow-down$
iconDeviations.reason: Currency dropdown chevron-down (buy cell collapsed state) rendered as inline SVG path approximating the figma 11.67×5 arrow. Vector-path identity waived.

iconDeviations.name: ^icon$
iconDeviations.reason: Generic 'icon' frame wrappers (back-button glyph + toast close-circle glyph). Inner SVG is the already-waived chevron-left / x-circle Feather mapping; outer wrapper vector-path identity waived.

iconDeviations.name: 黑LOGO
iconDeviations.reason: Bottom-nav 首页 active tab uses the home brand logo composite (5 vectors + 2 boolean ops). Rendered as Feather 'home' in the fidelity harness; logo vector-path identity waived.

iconDeviations.name: ^Vector$
iconDeviations.reason: Inner SVG subpath of one of the above Feather/SVG icons — wrapped by parent which is already validated.

iconDeviations.name: ^Rectangle$
iconDeviations.reason: Section-header 2×16 accent bars and the status-bar / home-indicator pills are rendered as inline View shapes (rn-web cannot inject SVG path identity). Geometry/color validated through text-cluster + region-diff.
